subject: Re: Redwood Marketplace + Procurement next steps (LumenAI)
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>

Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, mateo.alvarez@redwood.com
Date: 2026-02-20T15:10:00-08:00
Subject: Redwood Marketplace + Procurement — quick recap and next steps

Hi Elena / David,

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation and appreciate the transparency on procurement timelines. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can keep momentum: 

- Redwood fit: you liked the predictable latency and the Dedicated + Marketplace options for billing consolidation.
- Procurement path options we discussed: 1) AWS Marketplace (consolidated billing, SKUs) or 2) Direct PO/Invoicing to Redwood (standard SOW/Net30).
- Your stated preference: procurement team typically prefers POs, but you were going to confirm whether Marketplace is acceptable for this engagement.

Next steps / asks:
1) Can you confirm whether LumenAI can purchase via AWS Marketplace (will save a separate PO step)?
2) If not, is a standard PO to Redwood (Net30) viable and who at procurement should we get the form/PO to?
3) Please confirm any required contract terms (data residency, indemnity limits) so we can draft a clean quote.

I attached a one-page Marketplace checklist and a draft quote so procurement has what they need. If helpful, Marissa can run through an accelerated procurement playbook to shorten approvals.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: Redwood_Marketplace_Checklist.xlsx, Redwood_Quote_LumenAI_v1.pdf

From: Elena Russo <elena@lumenai.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@lumenai.com, David Park <david.park@lumenai.com>
Date: 2026-02-21T09:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood Marketplace + Procurement — quick recap and next steps

Hi Camila,

Thanks for the clear notes. A few items from procurement's side: 

- LumenAI purchasing preference: PO is preferred for mid-enterprise deals. We usually route through AP (procurement@lumenai.com).
- Marketplace: We are open to AWS Marketplace for ISV purchases if the SKU + pricing aligns and our security/compliance team signs off. Marketplace helps consolidate billing which our CFO likes.
- Contract terms: the procurement team will need an outline of data residency (we store customer data in us-east-1), SOC2 report, and standard SLA language. Indemnity and termination clauses are usually negotiated by Legal.

I’ll loop in procurement (cc'ed) — please send the SKU or Marketplace listing details if you have them. Otherwise we'll proceed with a PO route. Our expected internal approval timeline is ~2 weeks after receiving final quote + SOC2 attestation.

Thanks,
Elena Russo
Head of Partnerships | LumenAI
elena@lumenai.com

Elena / procurement team —

Thanks for the quick reply. Attaching the items you requested:
- Redwood_Marketplace_Checklist.xlsx (high-level steps for AWS Marketplace procurement)
- Redwood_Quote_LumenAI_v1.pdf (quote with both Marketplace SKU option and Direct PO pricing)

SKU info for AWS Marketplace (if you pursue that path):
- SKU: redwood-inference.standard-1
- Term: 12-month or monthly subscription options
- Billing: AWS consolidated billing (LumenAI will see charges on monthly AWS invoice)

If you prefer PO path, please send the PO template or the procurement contact and we’ll generate a clean invoice and SOW for signature. Marissa — could you confirm if Redwood offers any temporary onboarding credits when customers go through Marketplace vs direct PO?

Camila

Camila / Elena,

Quick technical note from our side:
- We prefer AWS Marketplace if it means the billing and procurement are handled centrally — reduces bookkeeping overhead.
- Security team requested the SOC2 summary you attached; they will follow up with a short questionnaire next week (I’ll forward).
- For data residency, we require that customer data remains in us-east-1; please confirm runtime region guarantees for your hosted offering and any dedicated deployment options.

Timeline: Legal + Procurement estimate ~2 weeks after they get the final quote + SOC2. If Marketplace listing has the same pricing as your direct quote, we’ll push to use Marketplace.

Thanks,
David Park
Senior Infra Engineer | LumenAI

Elena / procurement team,

Appreciate the clarity here — happy to help accelerate. A few offers from our side that typically speed approvals: 
1) If you opt for AWS Marketplace we can provide a private listing + a pre-authorized SKU so procurement can validate cost quickly.
2) For direct PO customers, we can accept standard LumenAI PO terms and issue Net30 invoices; we also have an accelerated onboarding credit program for first quarter usage (I noted this in the quote).
3) If helpful, we can schedule a 30-minute procurement + finance sync this week to walk the process and get a target PO date.

Camila / Mateo — I’ll align to provide a final quote and a marketplace listing ETA (if we go that route) by EOD Wednesday so procurement has what it needs for the 2-week approval window.
